verses.gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੁਇ ਪਾਰਗ੍ਰਾਮੀ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਮੀਪ ਬੂਡਿ ਮਰਤ ਅਭਾਗੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bohith praves bhe nirabhai hui paaragraamee bohith sameep boodd marat abhaage hai ||

en.bdb: Once someone boards a ship, he is confident of sailing across the sea. But many unfortunates die even when the ship is near about.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸੋ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੋਹਿ ਦੂਰੰਤਰ ਤਰੁ ਗੰਧ ਮਾਰੁਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan sameep dhuraga(n)dh so suga(n)dh hoh dhoora(n)tar tar ga(n)dh maarut na laage hai ||

en.bdb: Fragrance less trees acquire fragrance when they grow near Sandalwood trees. But those trees which are located far away do not receive fragrant breeze of Sandalwood as it cannot reach them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਾਰਿ ਗਰ ਹਾਰ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਦੇਸਿ ਕੁਲ ਦੀਪਕ ਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sihajaa sa(n)jog bhog naar gar haar hot purakh bidhes kul dheepak na jaage hai ||

en.bdb: To enjoy the pleasure of nocturnal bed, a faithful wife clings to her husband. But one whose husband is away don't even feel like lighting a lamp in her home.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਲ ਅਨੁਰਾਗੇ ਹੈ ॥੭੯॥
verses.translit_en: sree gur kirapaa nidhaan simaran giaan dhiaan gurmukh sukh fal pal anuraage hai ||79||

en.bdb: Similarly, a Gursikh who holds the Guru close receives comfort by following the teachings of the Guru and meditating upon the Name that the Guru has blessed him with. One who does not feel the presence of Vaheguru cannot attain peace. (79)
